steps.label: scrollbar
steps.js: () => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *')).filter(e => e.scrollHeight > e.clientHeight + 20).map(e => ({ tag: e.tagName, cls: (e.className || '').toString().slice(0, 40), overflowY: getComputedStyle(e).overflowY, sh: e.scrollHeight, ch: e.clientHeight, rect: (r => ({ x: Math.round(r.x), y: Math.round(r.y), w: Math.round(r.width), h: Math.round(r.height) }))(e.getBoundingClientRect()) })).slice(0, 8)

steps.label: scrolla-alla
steps.js: () => { const out = []; for (const e of document.querySelectorAll('body *')) { if (e.scrollHeight > e.clientHeight + 20) { e.scrollTop = 500; out.push({ tag: e.tagName, scrollTop: e.scrollTop, sh: e.scrollHeight }); } } return out.slice(0, 8); }
